subject: Re: [Project Nimbus] Kickoff: ASVI for the probabilistic modeling stack
body:
Anders,

Project Nimbus staffing and resource plan:

- Umar 60% (research lead, owns the Inference Gym comparison design)
- Tereza 50% (pipeline + reproducibility)
- Rosa 30% (API surface, ramping to 50% in June once her other commitments taper)

Compute is light - VI fits are single-node, so titan-a100 best-effort covers us; the full posterior-comparison sweep across Inference Gym models is a few hundred GPU-hours total. No Vulcan ask, which keeps us out of the reservation queue entirely.

One process note: since Nimbus targets an internal API rather than an external demo, I'd like to confirm with Nadia whether we still need full LRB sign-off or just an architecture review. Can you take that?

Brownian-motion repro already matches: final ELBO within 0.3 nats of the released run.

Santiago
